original.statement: In Loki 3.0.0 the embedded cache metrics are renamed: querier_cache_added_new_total, querier_cache_evicted_total, querier_cache_entries and querier_cache_memory_bytes become loki_embeddedcache_added_new_total, loki_embeddedcache_evicted_total, loki_embeddedcache_entries and loki_embeddedcache_memory_bytes respectively.

decision.reason: [ev-1f9807113c9e] says four embedded cache metrics are renamed, each from its `querier_cache_*` name to the matching `loki_embeddedcache_*` name. That is one consistent rename of the prefix, not a bundle of unrelated changes, so a single renamed assertion with a same-family replacedBy fits. No family covers metric names, which leaves free-form protocol-behavior names built from the two prefixes as the closest fit. The removed metrics in the same section [ev-dd7907f24ce5][ev-53101f583cb5] are separate changes and are not part of this rename. Confidence is low because metric exposition fits the protocol-behavior family only loosely, and the name 'querier-cache-metrics' could be read as also covering those removed metrics.
